description: Source code for Huffman encoding implementation used in HTTP/2 header compression within the quiche library, including functions for size calculation and fast encoding.

methods.name: HuffmanSize
methods.description: Calculates the size in bytes of the Huffman encoded version of the input string.

methods.name: HuffmanEncode
methods.description: Encodes the input string into Huffman coding, appending the result to the provided string buffer.

methods.name: HuffmanEncodeFast
methods.description: Performs Huffman encoding with optimized buffer handling, appending the result to the output string.
